results.snippet:
###### Summary:

 Niger halted exports of diesel and premium petrol to tackle recent fuel supply issues.
 The trade and industry ministry announced the move in a Facebook post, stressing local output is mainly for the home market.
 Exports can happen only when there is a surplus, handled by SONIDEP or SORAZ, and only with a special license. SORAZ is China-controlled.

results.snippet:
The second match will take place at the Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium in Rabat, with Ethiopian referee Tewodros Mitiku selected to officiate the contest.

Mitiku will be accompanied by an all-Ethiopian officiating crew, with compatriots Fasika Biru Yehualashet and Tigle Gizaw Belachew acting as assistant referees.

The Moroccan national team is scheduled to face Niger in Casablanca on November 13
